baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of a new appearance, prior seeing, plural signs, emphatic imprisonment, and a limited time.
baseline_models.mechanism: Acknowledged visible evidence does not prevent confinement; it precipitates a new collective policy that removes the evidenced person from circulation.

activation_trace.role: An arising new opinion makes the detention decision a reversal rather than the continuation of an settled judgment.
Sight and inward perception establish that the group has apprehended evidence rather than acting from simple ignorance.
A manifest mark supplies the visible evidence whose recognition immediately precedes the policy change.
Confinement in a holding place supplies the operational response to what has become visible.
A span of time limits the policy without naming a juridical endpoint, leaving it provisional.

changed_reading.before: They imprison him despite having seen some evidence.
changed_reading.after: The seeing itself generates a changed policy: evidence is converted from a truth-disclosing resource into a reason to contain its bearer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The double temporal framing, after and until a time, encloses the emphatic prison decision.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group does not announce a final verdict; it creates an institutional pause after evidence, waiting for an unnamed future condition before reconsideration.

activation_trace.role: Temporal aftermath places the decision downstream of completed perception and makes delay part of the mechanism.
A newly arising opinion marks the pause as an improvised policy rather than a settled sentence.
The holding place becomes the material instrument for suspending resolution.
Waiting for the right time turns the unnamed duration into a strategy of deferral.
Assigning a time to an act suggests administrative timing even though the actual term remains undisclosed.

changed_reading.before: Until a time merely states the duration of a prison sentence.
changed_reading.after: Prison functions as a waiting device: it postpones decision after the signs rather than resolving what the signs mean.

context_deltas.mechanism: A failed private architecture of coercion is scaled into an institutional one: sealed household doors, flight to the threshold, and staged emergence culminate in prison.

activation_trace.role: Coercive narrowing makes the first enclosure an instrument for controlling access and movement.
The doorway supplies a boundary between imposed privacy and possible escape.
Racing ahead makes control of the boundary an active contest rather than a static setting.
The repeated threshold acts as the limit where private control breaks and evidence becomes externally visible.
Extraction from concealment reverses the closed-door scene into a controlled public display.
The prison holding place institutionalizes the enclosure that the household could not sustain privately.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from doors sealed in 12:23, through a race to the repeated threshold in 12:25, to commanded public emergence in 12:31 and official confinement in 12:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same body is successively enclosed, escapes toward a boundary, is displayed, and is imprisoned. Reader: prison is the public-scale replacement for failed private enclosure. Alternative: the prison may answer scandal or disobedience without intentionally repeating the house's spatial logic.

changed_reading.before: Prison is a new punitive location introduced at the end of the episode.
changed_reading.after: Prison is the escalation of an existing control technology, replacing a penetrable private enclosure with an institutional one.

context_deltas.mechanism: Material inspection and testimony stabilize an exculpatory reading, but the immediate response is disengagement and covering; imprisonment extends that suppression from speech to the evidenced person.

activation_trace.role: A lengthwise tear supplies a directional material mark capable of testing the accusation.
Knowledge-based declaration converts the material mark into articulated evidence.
Established soundness gives the rear-tear inference a stable exculpatory result.
Direct inspection closes the gap between proposed test and acknowledged result.
Turning aside changes the household response from adjudicating the evidence to suppressing its continuation.
Protective covering activates scandal containment alongside the explicit moral demand for forgiveness.
The focus plural gathers the prior visible marks as the acknowledged material that detention must manage.
Confinement shifts suppression from the report to the bearer of the exculpatory signs.

structural_cues: 12:25-28 progresses from a directional tear to a conditional test, an explicit truth/lie result, and visual confirmation; 12:29 then orders disengagement rather than public correction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the evidence is inspected, yields a truth assignment, and is followed by an order to turn away. Reader: 12:35 extends that order into detention because exculpatory evidence threatens household control. Alternative: the signs may include the later bodily reactions, and prison may target scandal generally rather than the legal evidence alone.

changed_reading.before: The signs are considered and then fail to prevent a mistaken punishment.
changed_reading.after: The signs succeed in revealing innocence, and precisely for that reason their bearer becomes a liability to be hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: A command to turn aside and cover the matter fails when speech becomes city-wide and audible; the unnamed prison term becomes a cooling interval for an uncontained reputation.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the first attempted strategy of ending attention without resolving it publicly.
Covering and protection give the attempted quieting a reputational as well as moral function.
Speech spreading among people demonstrates that the quieting attempt has failed.
Public renown turns a private event into a persistent social circulation problem.
Waiting for an opportune time makes detention a cooling strategy whose endpoint depends on changed conditions.
Physical confinement substitutes for the failed attempt to confine speech.

structural_cues: The order to disengage in 12:29 is immediately followed by city speech in 12:30 and a response to what has been heard in 12:31.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: attempted quieting is followed by wider speech and reaction. Reader: the unspecified term in 12:35 lasts until social attention cools. Alternative: the term may instead track coercive compliance, an administrative review, or an unstated release decision.

changed_reading.before: Until a time is an arbitrary or conventional sentence length.
changed_reading.after: The duration is condition-sensitive: confinement buys time for public attention to decay after verbal suppression fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: The scandal moves from city speech to a staged collective gaze that leaves bodily marks; prison quarantines the person whose repeated visibility produces socially contagious reactions.

activation_trace.role: Widely circulating speech turns the household episode into a public narrative.
The gathered city expands the scale of concern from one household to a social field.
Renown among people supplies the transmission channel that prompts the staged response.
Being brought out from concealment makes visibility deliberately produced rather than accidental.
Mutual facing turns sight into a staged collective encounter whose effects can be compared.
Physical cutting leaves fresh bodily marks that can join the focus plural of visible signs.
Manifest marks can gather both juridical evidence and the visible bodily aftermath of collective seeing.
Confinement removes the recurrent object of public display from the network of sight and speech.

structural_cues: 12:30 publicizes the affair; 12:31 deliberately assembles viewers, commands emergence, records collective sight, and produces cut hands before the prison threat is restated in 12:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: public speech leads to staged viewing and visible bodily injury. Reader: those injuries belong among the plural signs, so detention controls repeat exposure. Alternative: the signs may refer narrowly to the shirt and testimony, while the spectacle only intensifies reputational pressure.

changed_reading.before: Prison hides an accused person after a private dispute.
changed_reading.after: Prison quarantines visibility itself: it removes a person whose public appearance repeatedly generates marks, speech, and loss of control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coercer couples prison to commanded compliance and humiliation, while the threatened person immediately prefers the same prison as the condition that preserves refusal; the focus therefore carries opposed valuations at once.

activation_trace.role: Demand and obligation make imprisonment the penalty attached to refusal of a command.
Confinement first enters as the coercer's explicit threatened sanction.
Abasement supplies the intended social meaning of that threatened sanction.
Protective holding frames refusal as active preservation rather than helpless noncompliance.
The same holding place is taken up in the threatened person's own comparison of outcomes.
Marked preference reverses prison's value from imposed shame to the more desirable of two constrained options.
Actual confinement preserves both incompatible readings: their coercive sanction and his chosen barrier.

structural_cues: 12:32 joins imprisonment to a command and humiliation; 12:33 immediately repeats prison in a first-person preference before 12:35 enacts it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one speaker threatens prison as abasement, and the threatened speaker prefers it to the invitation. Reader: his revaluation remains active when their decision is enacted. Alternative: 12:35 may foreground only the group's coercive intention even though the prior preference changes the reader's valuation.

changed_reading.before: Prison has one stable meaning: punitive defeat imposed by those in power.
changed_reading.after: The same prison is semantically contested, remaining their instrument of humiliation while becoming his material means of preserving refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The requested diversion from a coercive plot is explicitly answered just before the human decision; imprisonment can therefore be read simultaneously as hostile agency and as the material route by which exposure is diverted.

activation_trace.role: Preventive holding establishes protection from coercion as the live problem that prison may unexpectedly solve.
The holding place is explicitly preferred as one possible route away from the competing invitation.
Strong preference identifies confinement as an acceptable protective means rather than merely a feared outcome.
Turning something from its course names the requested directional change away from the coercive pressure.
A calculated stratagem identifies the hazard from which diversion is requested.
Response to speech marks the preceding appeal as answered rather than merely uttered.
Transfer from one condition to another states that the requested diversion has occurred.
The subsequent holding place can materialize the answered change by separating him from renewed access.

structural_cues: 12:33 prefers prison and asks for the plot to be turned away; 12:34 states response and diversion; 12:35 then reports the group's newly arising prison decision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the appeal, response, diversion, and later imprisonment are sequentially adjacent. Reader: the prison decision is one means through which the answered diversion takes durable form. Alternative: the answer may concern only immediate inward or situational protection, with imprisonment remaining a separate hostile act.

changed_reading.before: The prison decision interrupts or contradicts the immediately preceding divine response.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be a human injustice, imprisonment may be the paradoxical medium through which the requested protection becomes durable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading links commercial, household, and carceral custody, so it is surprising and should not be rendered as lexical equivalence. It remains anchored in the focus act of confinement and in the repeated handling of the same person; downstream prose should call it a recurring social recoding rather than a hidden legal thesis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The emphatic act of imprisoning him changes his administratively manageable status by immobilizing him.

activation_trace.role: Concealment begins a pattern in which visibility is controlled by assigning the person a manageable status.
A portion of wealth made into merchandise supplies the first explicit administrative recoding.
Exchange through sale moves the person between regimes of custody.
Taking and acquisition shifts the status from merchandise toward household incorporation.
Residence and settlement locate that new status within a household.
Institutional confinement recodes the same person again, now as a subject whose movement is suspended.

changed_reading.before: Imprisonment is an isolated punishment unrelated to the earlier economic narrative.
changed_reading.after: Imprisonment is the latest custody conversion in a sequence that moves him from hidden merchandise, to household acquisition, to immobilized institutional subject.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's form-distant mapped branch from sight to deliberation, so it is too distant to replace the ordinary sense of seeing. It remains anchored in the focus perception clause and in repeated inspections and judgments; downstream prose should present it only as a resonance of review and reconsideration.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combination of seeing the signs and a newly arising opinion can resonate with deliberation after review.

activation_trace.role: Deliberation over an affair activates a review layer beneath the ordinary act of seeing.
The new opinion supplies the changed result of that possible review.
Direct visual inspection provides the concrete evidentiary event later subject to reconsideration.
Evaluative opinion shows that seeing in the sequence already moves between perception and judgment.
Collective facing adds a staged repetition of sight before the final policy shift.

changed_reading.before: They see the signs once and then abruptly choose prison.
changed_reading.after: The decision follows a chain of inspection, public evaluation, staged re-seeing, and reconsideration, with prison emerging after review rather than after one glance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant activation from the packet's secondary mapping of the focus root, so it must not be translated as the clause's direct meaning. It remains anchored in the new-opinion verb and the emphatic prison construction; downstream prose should describe a resonance of manufactured necessity, not grammatical compulsion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A newly appearing collective opinion hardens immediately into an emphatic certainty of imprisonment.

activation_trace.role: Inescapable necessity activates the possibility that the group presents its new policy as admitting no alternative.
A severity that fixes its object reinforces the rhetorical hardening from option into necessity.
Waiting for an unnamed time lets necessity remain in force without stating what could end it.

changed_reading.before: A new policy option occurs to the group.
changed_reading.after: The group rhetorically converts its new option into an unavoidable necessity, even though the acknowledged signs should have opened alternatives.

strongest_changes: The signs do not merely fail to prevent prison; exculpatory visibility becomes a liability that prison suppresses.
Prison carries opposed values at once: coercive humiliation for those imposing it and protective refuge for the person confined.
The human decision can also function as the paradoxical material continuation of the immediately preceding answered diversion.
The unnamed term reads as strategic deferral or reputational cooling rather than a resolved verdict.
summary.what_was_special: The focus reverses the expected evidentiary arrow: seeing produces containment. Context preserves several mechanisms for that reversal without forcing a choice among evidence suppression, public-visibility quarantine, coercive punishment, protective refuge, answered diversion, and institutionalized enclosure.
remaining_uncertainties: The plural signs may gather the torn garment and testimony, the women's bodily reactions, the broader sequence of proofs, or more than one of these.
It is uncertain whether the response and diversion in 12:34 include imprisonment as their durable means or end before the human decision in 12:35.
The group denoted by the plural decision and the condition that ends the unnamed time are not specified in the focus.
The deliberation and no-alternative outliers rely on form-distant mapped branches and must remain resonances rather than lexical claims.
